title: Camels in a Changing Climate: Enhancing LM Adaptation with Tulu 2
authors_zh: Hamish Ivison, Yizhong Wang, Valentina Pyatkin, Nathan Lambert, Matthew Peters, Pradeep Dasigi, Joel Jang, David Wadden, Noah A. Smith, Iz Beltagy, Hannaneh Hajishirzi
paper_type_zh: 开放指令微调与偏好优化配方
best_for_zh: 适合从 SFT 数据、DPO 反馈、checkpoint 和评测四个层面构建或审计开放助手的研究者。
one_line: Tulu 2 connects a 326K instruction mixture, scalable DPO, open checkpoints, and common evaluation in one reproducible adaptation suite.
Tulu 2 把 32.6 万条指令混合数据、可扩展 DPO、开放 checkpoint 和统一评测连接成可复现的适配套件。
why: It exposes which instruction records and preference pairs drive each stage of an open assistant recipe.
inclusion_reason: Tulu 2 is an open adaptation recipe that exposes instruction mixtures, SFT, DPO, checkpoints, and evaluation code.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open instruction-tuned models were often released without enough detail to separate gains from the instruction mixture, base model, preference optimization, or evaluation setup. This made assistant-adaptation results difficult to reproduce and compare.

Tulu 2 builds an open adaptation suite around a new 326,154-example instruction mixture: supervised fine-tune Llama 2 and Code Llama, optionally apply DPO with preference pairs, and release the data, code, checkpoints, and evaluation recipe. The result is an inspectable path from instruction records and preference judgments to general and code assistants up to 70B parameters.

L4 facts: primary source https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10702; arXiv technical report, 2023; boundary: post-training data and feedback, not pretraining; atlas value: mixture lineage plus SFT/DPO contracts; evaluation surface: MMLU, GSM8K, BBH, TydiQA, Codex-Eval, TruthfulQA, ToxiGen, AlpacaEval, and MT-Bench.

开放的指令微调模型通常没有提供足够细节，因而很难区分性能提升来自指令混合数据、基座模型、偏好优化还是评测设置，也难以复现和公平比较不同的助手适配方案。

Tulu 2 围绕一个包含 326,154 条样本的新指令混合数据构建开放适配套件：先对 Llama 2 和 Code Llama 做监督微调，再选择性地使用偏好对进行 DPO，并公开数据、代码、checkpoint 和评测配方。最终产出是一条可检查的链路，从指令记录和偏好判断一直连接到规模最高为 70B 的通用及代码助手。

L4 事实：主要来源为 https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10702；2023 年 arXiv 技术报告；边界是后训练数据与反馈，而非预训练；图谱价值是同时呈现混合数据来源和 SFT/DPO 监督契约；评测覆盖 MMLU、GSM8K、BBH、TydiQA、Codex-Eval、TruthfulQA、ToxiGen、AlpacaEval 和 MT-Bench。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Tulu 2's contribution is an openly documented adaptation package in which instruction-response records supervise SFT, preference pairs supervise DPO, and a common harness evaluates the resulting checkpoints. Compared with Tulu V1 and one-shot data releases such as LiMA, it makes the mixture revision, later preference stage, model scaling, and evaluation outputs inspectable as separate objects. This belongs in a data primer because it exposes how heterogeneous post-training data and feedback are assembled and consumed.

Google Scholar citations: 315（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Camels+in+a+Changing+Climate%3A+Enhancing+LM+Adaptation+with+Tulu+2&author=Hamish+Ivison&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Tulu V2 SFT Mixture, https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/tulu-v2-sft-mixture, contains 326,154 instruction-response examples drawn from FLAN V2 CoT, Open Assistant, ShareGPT, GPT-4-Alpaca, Code-Alpaca, LIMA, WizardLM, Open-Orca, hard-coded prompts, and a 7,544-example science mixture. It is distributed through Hugging Face with source/configuration fields and conversation or instruction-response records for supervised fine-tuning; formats and licenses remain source-dependent. Code and checkpoints are at https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct and https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/tulu-v2-suite-6551b56e743e6349aab45101.

Tulu 2 的贡献是一套文档完整的开放适配包，其中指令—回答记录监督 SFT，偏好对监督 DPO，统一评测工具比较最终 checkpoint。与 Tulu V1 和 LiMA 这类一次性数据发布相比，它把混合数据修订、后续偏好训练、模型规模和评测输出拆成可分别检查的对象。它适合作为数据入门论文，是因为清楚展示了异质后训练数据和反馈如何被组合并用于训练。

Google Scholar 引用数：315（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Camels+in+a+Changing+Climate%3A+Enhancing+LM+Adaptation+with+Tulu+2&author=Hamish+Ivison&hl=en）

开源数据：有。Tulu V2 SFT Mixture 位于 https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/tulu-v2-sft-mixture，共 326,154 条指令—回答样本，来源包括 FLAN V2 CoT、Open Assistant、ShareGPT、GPT-4-Alpaca、Code-Alpaca、LIMA、WizardLM、Open-Orca、固定提示和 7,544 条科学数据。数据通过 Hugging Face 发布，带有来源或配置字段以及对话或指令—回答记录，可用于监督微调；具体格式和许可证随原始来源而异。代码与 checkpoint 分别位于 https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct 和 https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/tulu-v2-suite-6551b56e743e6349aab45101。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the mixture. Input: public instruction datasets and task collections. Operation: revise Tulu V1 by removing weak sources and adding dialogue, code, CoT, Orca, WizardLM, LIMA, and science records. Output: 326,154 SFT examples. Check: retain source identity, licenses, and exact dataset revision.
  1. Supervised fine-tune. Input: Tulu V2 mixture and Llama 2 or Code Llama bases at 7B, 13B, and 70B. Operation: train on target responses with the paper's full-finetuning recipe. Output: Tulu 2 and Code Tulu 2 checkpoints. Check: pin base checkpoint, sequence length, mixture weights, and optimizer settings.
  1. Add preference optimization. Input: Tulu 2 checkpoints and UltraFeedback preference pairs. Operation: run three DPO epochs with learning rate 5e-7; the 70B run uses a 512-core TPUv3 for about seven days. Output: Tulu 2 + DPO checkpoints. Check: monitor stability, verbosity, multilingual regression, and train/evaluation overlap.
  1. Evaluate and release. Input: SFT-only and DPO checkpoints. Operation: run the shared capability, safety, code, and open-ended-generation suite. Output: per-task scores, aggregate comparisons, code, data, and checkpoints. Check: compare models under the same prompts and decoding rules; do not attribute a joint recipe gain to data alone.

1. 构建混合数据。 输入是公开指令数据集和任务集合。作者修订 Tulu V1，移除效果较弱的来源，并加入对话、代码、CoT、Orca、WizardLM、LIMA 和科学类记录，产出 326,154 条 SFT 样本。检查时应保留每条数据的来源标识、许可证和精确版本。
  1. 监督微调。 输入是 Tulu V2 混合数据，以及 7B、13B、70B 的 Llama 2 或 Code Llama 基座。按照论文配方用目标回答进行全参数微调，产出 Tulu 2 和 Code Tulu 2 checkpoint。复现时需固定基座 checkpoint、序列长度、混合权重和优化器设置。
  1. 加入偏好优化。 输入是 Tulu 2 checkpoint 和 UltraFeedback 偏好对。以 5e-7 学习率运行三轮 DPO；70B 模型使用 512 核 TPUv3，训练约七天，产出 Tulu 2 + DPO checkpoint。检查稳定性、回答冗长度、多语言退化以及训练数据与评测集重叠。
  1. 评测并发布。 输入是仅经过 SFT 和进一步经过 DPO 的 checkpoint。用统一工具评测能力、安全、代码和开放式生成，输出逐任务分数、汇总比较、代码、数据与模型。只有提示和解码规则相同时才能比较，也不能把整套配方的收益只归因于数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
End-to-end 70B comparison (Table 1). Tulu 2 + DPO 70B averages 72.1 across MMLU, GSM8K, BBH, TydiQA, Codex-Eval, TruthfulQA, and ToxiGen, versus 72.3 for GPT-3.5-turbo-0301. The configurations are not identical: Tulu is an open Llama 2 70B model trained on the released SFT mixture and UltraFeedback DPO pairs, while the proprietary model's training data and size are unknown. The result supports competitiveness of the full open recipe, not a data-only causal claim.

DPO scaling (Tables 3–4). Holding the Tulu V2 SFT stage and model family fixed, adding DPO raises open-ended AlpacaEval and MT-Bench results at 7B, 13B, and 70B; at 70B, MT-Bench reaches 7.89 and AlpacaEval 95.1. DPO uses UltraFeedback, three epochs, and learning rate 5e-7; the paper also reports longer answers and weaker multilingual behavior, so the preference-stage gain is not uniform capability improvement.

70B 端到端比较（表 1）。 Tulu 2 + DPO 70B 在 MMLU、GSM8K、BBH、TydiQA、Codex-Eval、TruthfulQA 和 ToxiGen 上的平均分为 72.1，GPT-3.5-turbo-0301 为 72.3。两者配置并不相同：Tulu 是用公开 SFT 混合数据和 UltraFeedback 偏好对训练的 Llama 2 70B 开放模型，而闭源模型的训练数据和规模未知。因此，该结果支持整套开放配方具有竞争力，不能作为数据单因素的因果证据。

DPO 规模实验（表 3–4）。 在固定 Tulu V2 SFT 阶段和模型家族后，加入 DPO 能提升 7B、13B、70B 模型的 AlpacaEval 和 MT-Bench 开放式生成结果；70B 的 MT-Bench 为 7.89，AlpacaEval 为 95.1。该阶段使用 UltraFeedback、三轮训练和 5e-7 学习率；论文也观察到回答变长和多语言能力下降，因此偏好训练的收益不能解释为所有能力普遍提升。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Tulu V1 and earlier instruction-tuning releases are the nearest baseline. Tulu 2 changes the mixture and joins it to a reproducible SFT, DPO, checkpoint, and evaluation stack, including a stable public 70B DPO run. The algorithms are not new; the novelty is an open empirical package that lets researchers distinguish instruction records, preference pairs, training stages, and evaluation claims. It therefore signals a practical standard for auditable post-training recipes rather than a new optimizer.
最接近的基线是 Tulu V1 和更早的指令微调发布。Tulu 2 更新了混合数据，并把它连接到可复现的 SFT、DPO、checkpoint 与评测栈，其中包括稳定公开的 70B DPO 训练。它没有发明新的训练算法；新意在于一套开放实证包，使研究者能分别检查指令记录、偏好对、训练阶段和评测主张。因此，这项工作代表的是可审计后训练配方的实践标准，而不是新优化器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Confounded recipe. Mixture, base model, scale, SFT, and DPO can change together, so aggregate gains do not isolate data quality; require matched ablations before making a causal claim.
  • Heterogeneous lineage. The mixture inherits different collection methods and licenses, and the paper reports possible evaluation overlap for DPO data; audit every source and revision before redistribution.
  • Preference side effects. DPO improves open-ended judgments but increases verbosity and hurts multilingual performance; test the target language and length distribution before adoption.

• 配方因素混杂。 混合数据、基座模型、规模、SFT 和 DPO 可能同时变化，因此总分提升不能单独说明数据质量更高；作因果判断前需要配置匹配的消融实验。
  • 来源链异质。 混合数据继承了不同的收集方式和许可证，而且论文指出 DPO 数据可能与部分评测重叠；再分发前应逐项核对来源与版本。
  • 偏好训练副作用。 DPO 提升开放式评判分数，但会增加回答长度并损害多语言表现；采用前必须在目标语言上检查能力和长度分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Tulu 2 when building or auditing an open general-purpose assistant. Start with a versioned instruction mixture and base checkpoint, reproduce SFT, optionally add versioned preference pairs for DPO, and output checkpoints plus per-stage evaluation records. Success means each gain can be tied to a documented data/training change and reproduced under fixed prompts. Do not copy the aggregate score when source licenses, contamination, language coverage, or the proprietary baseline configuration are unresolved.
构建或审计开放通用助手时，可以直接复用 Tulu 2 的工作分解。先固定指令混合数据和基座 checkpoint 的版本并复现 SFT，再按需要加入有版本记录的偏好对进行 DPO，最终产出 checkpoint 和逐阶段评测记录。成功标准是每项收益都能对应到有文档的数据或训练变化，并在固定提示下复现。若来源许可证、污染、多语言覆盖或闭源基线配置仍不明确，就不应直接搬用汇总分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep: Tulu 2 is a linked post-training package, not just a model or dataset release.
  2. Data decision: preserve each of the 326,154 SFT records' source and license instead of flattening the mixture.
  3. Training decision: evaluate SFT-only and SFT+DPO checkpoints separately so preference gains remain visible.
  4. Do not infer: the 72.1 aggregate does not show parity on every task or isolate the cause of performance.
  5. Audit first: pin mixture, base, UltraFeedback revision, prompts, decoding, language, and output length.

1. 应记住： Tulu 2 是一套相互连接的后训练产物，而不只是模型或数据集发布。
  2. 数据决策： 不要把混合数据压平，应保留 326,154 条 SFT 记录各自的来源和许可证。
  3. 训练决策： 分开评测仅 SFT 和经过 SFT+DPO 的 checkpoint，避免掩盖偏好训练的影响。
  4. 不能推出： 72.1 的汇总分不代表每个任务都与闭源模型持平，也没有隔离性能来源。
  5. 扩展前审计： 固定混合数据、基座、UltraFeedback 版本、提示、解码、目标语言和输出长度。
